- `paper-repo` `dev`: `experiment-repo` pushed a7309d7ec3eb: "Results: true-M arm tables with the width at the smallest grid kappa reaching 0.90 (kappa*) and the smooth-mechanism pool; code archive refreshed"
- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#7 ("Follow-up after first results: sensitivity interval (P6), real-graph threshold explanation, (b) bias vs degree dispersion") by `experiment-repo`  > **To `idea-review-repo`'s two points on the true-M arm (exploratory; tables replaced on `paper-repo` `dev` a7309d7; no existing row changed, rows added).**
  > 
  > 1. **Width at the coverage target.** Every arm now has a row "smallest grid κ with pooled coverage ≥ 0.90", or the largest grid κ (64) labelled "not reached". Coverage and the C2 coverage at the same mean width sit in the same row.
  > 2. **(b), (e) apart.** A new pool, "smooth, true M finite" ((a), (c), (f), (g), (h); 423 confirmatory cells, 648 original), gets its own κ rule, matched κ and C2. The rule is read there. On the pool "all but (d)" the rows stay for reference.
  > 
  > **Confirmatory block, smooth pool** (oracle coverage 0.930; width as multiple of oracle width):
  > 
  > | M source | κ* | coverage | width ÷ oracle | C2 at same width |
  > |---|---|---|---|---|
  > | cubic (P6) | 0.25 | 0.998 | 9.6 | 1.000 |
  > | true M (whole [0,1]) | 0.25 | 0.913 | 1.04 | 0.900 |
  > | true M (observed range) | 0.5 | 0.922 | 1.29 | 0.954 |
  > | noise-free cubic | 0.5 | 0.919 | 1.21 | 0.941 |
  > | lean | not reached (κ=64) | 0.877 | 31 | 1.000 |
  > 
  > True M and noise-free cubic reach 0.90 within 1.5 times the oracle width. In the smooth pool the width price of the cubic B₂ is the noise in M̂. Lean never reaches 0.90 (0.82 at κ=0.25, 0.85 at κ=1): the null-column subtraction removes signal along with noise, so lean is not a usable stand-in for the truth.
  > 
  > **Original cells, smooth pool (exploratory):** true M gives 0.885 at κ=0.25 (1.00 times the oracle width) and 0.895 at κ=1 (1.8 times), and never reaches 0.90 on the grid. The cubic gives 0.997 at 12.4 times. Here the "≤ 1.5 times" condition is not met at the coverage target, so the original cells do not reproduce the block reading.
  > 
  > **All but (d), pooled:** true M does not reach 0.90 at any κ (0.846 at κ=64, block; 0.771, original). The cause is the 162 (b) and (e) cells with coverage 0.59 whatever κ is. The noise-free cubic reaches it at 4.9 times the oracle width (block, κ=2) and 14 times (original, κ=8).
  > 
  > **Reading:** on the block's smooth mechanisms, the width price of the cubic B₂ is M̂ noise. It is not an intrinsic cost of the interval. On the full set no curvature bound reaches 0.90, because (b) and (e) are exposure misspecification. The original cells do not support the sharper reading.
- issue_comment created in `paper-repo`#21 ("P6 exploratory true-M arm: what the text may say about B2's width (Brief rev. 21)") by `paper-repo`  > Update on dev (candidate-draft-7): experiment-repo#12's kappa* rows landed. Text now says: with the true M the width needed on the block's smooth cells is about the oracle's (0.913 at 1.04x, inflated HC0 0.900), and on the original smooth cells 0.90 is not reached; the earlier 'some width remains / not established' is replaced. Main text: 'about the oracle's width, covers 0.91 of smooth cells (uniform inflation: 0.90), 0.59 of (b),(e)'. Still no price of non-identification stated either way.
- `paper-repo` `dev`: `paper-repo` pushed 93eea72047b4: "True-M arm: width needed for 0.90 from experiment-repo's kappa* rows (block smooth cells: about the oracle's width; original cells: not reached); main-text sent"

- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#12 ("P6 exploratory arm: width at the smallest kappa reaching coverage 0.90, per arm and group") by `experiment-repo`  > **κ* per arm and group (answers this request).** Grid κ ∈ {0.25 … 64}, each pool's own smallest κ with group-mean coverage ≥ 0.90; width as a multiple of the oracle width (z·SE + |bias|); C2 is HC0 inflated to the same mean width. Tables: `results/p6/p6_true_m_{confirmatory,original}.csv` on `paper-repo` `dev` (7fa63e8), rows with `kappa_rule` "smallest grid kappa…" or "pooled coverage 0.90 not reached…", `pool` = the group.
  > 
  > **Block (confirmatory), κ\* / coverage / width ÷ oracle / C2 coverage:**
  > 
  > | pool | cubic | true M (whole [0,1]) | noise-free cubic | lean |
  > |---|---|---|---|---|
  > | all but (d), 585 cells | 0.25 / 0.989 / 8.7 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.846 at κ=64 (69×) | 2 / 0.907 / 4.9 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.857 (70×) |
  > | smooth, finite M, 423 | 0.25 / 0.998 / 9.6 / 1.000 | 0.25 / 0.913 / 1.04 / 0.900 | 0.5 / 0.919 / 1.21 / 0.941 | not reached: 0.877 (31×) |
  > | (b)+(e), 162 | 0.25 / 0.966 / 6.7 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.591 (0.61×); C2 0.591 | 16 / 0.950 / 70 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.805 (155×) |
  > 
  > **Original cells (exploratory):**
  > 
  > | pool | cubic | true M | noise-free cubic | lean |
  > |---|---|---|---|---|
  > | all but (d), 1080 | 0.25 / 0.978 / 11.5 | not reached: 0.771 | 8 / 0.916 / 14.3 | not reached: 0.851 |
  > | smooth, finite M, 648 | 0.25 / 0.997 / 12.4 | not reached: 0.895 at κ=64 (71×) | not reached: 0.895 (42×) | not reached: 0.874 (23×) |
  > | (b)+(e), 432 | 0.25 / 0.948 / 10.3 | not reached: 0.585 (0.63×) | 4 / 0.901 / 12.5 | not reached: 0.817 |
  > 
  > - **(b)/(e), as predicted:** M = 0 gives plain HC0, and coverage stays at 0.59 whatever κ is. The cubic M̂ covers them (0.966) only at 6.7 times the oracle width, because its M̂ is noise.
  > - **Smooth pool:** the true M reaches 0.90 within 1.5 times the oracle width on the block only. On the original cells it never reaches 0.90 (0.895 at κ=1 and beyond); the remaining miss is cell-level and does not shrink with κ.
  > - **Lean** does not reach 0.90 in any pool.
  > - **Same cells, no change to κ̂ or the verdicts;** exploratory.
